title: unified-rollouts-add-preflight-canary-ab-shadow-autorollback-workflow
author: Priya Shah
description:
Motivation: production rollouts for model variants (canary, A/B, shadow) require deterministic preflight probing and a consolidated autorollback workflow that works across hosting modes (hosted/dedicated/private). This PR adds a preflight probing stage, quarantine/probing metrics quorum, integrated A/B canary stage definitions, shadow traffic probing, and a single autorollback engine that evaluates composite metrics and enforces safety guards.

What this changes (high level): added a preflight workflow that runs a small, deterministic probe set against a candidate model before traffic split; expanded rollout spec to support combined canary + A/B + shadow topologies; implemented a quarantine/probing stage used when metric quorum is inconclusive; extended autorollback engine to accept composite metrics (latency/error/regression score) with quorum and hysteresis; hooked observability to emit per-stage telemetry and tracing; added end-to-end tests and CI job for preflight and quarantine flows.

Checklist: [x] design doc referenced (ENG-4321) [x] unit tests added [x] integration tests added [x] e2e preflight scenarios [x] docs/observability notes updated [x] metrics instrumentation added

Why this is safe: new preflight stage runs isolated probes (no customer traffic) and cannot change live routing until it passes. Autorollback defaults are conservative; quarantine stage requires manual ack to progress if metric quorum is not met. Backwards-compatible with existing rollout specs; default behavior unchanged unless new fields are used.

Summary of commits: see commits field.

Notes: This PR touches core rollout engine; recommended to monitor rollout.telemetry.preflight_failure_rate and rollout.autorollback.invocations in staging after deploy.

review_comments: Ethan Chen: Nice end-to-end shape. A few asks: (1) make preflight timeout configurable per-stage, (2) clarify what happens to KV cache during preflight probes (should be isolated), (3) can we add a small dashboard screenshot to the PR description so reviewers can see expected metrics?

Priya Shah: Thanks Ethan — addressed timeout and added preflight timeout field to spec; probe runner now namespaces KV cache to avoid collisions; added dashboard snapshot to observability/dashboards and included in description.
Marta Gomez: Question on quorum: if one metric is flaky, do we allow quorum-over-time? Suggest adding hysteresis to avoid oscillation.
Priya Shah: Implemented hysteresis and added unit tests that cover oscillation case. See autorollback.py: CompositeEvaluator with time-windowed aggregate and cooldown TTL.
Liam O'Connor: e2e flake repro noted on first CI run (timeout on probe container). After increasing docker resource limit the job passed. Approving once CI green.
Ethan Chen: Approve — good to merge after one more e2e run in staging to validate metrics emissions.
release_notes: Add preflight probing workflow and enhanced autorollback: supports combined canary/A-B/shadow rollouts, composite metric quorum, quarantine stage for inconclusive probes, observability for preflight and autorollback events. Defaults are conservative and backwards-compatible.
